The combination of Flutter and MongoDB is perfect for modern applications that need to handle large volumes of unstructured data while delivering a seamless user experience across iOS, Android, and Web platforms.

Flutter + FastAPI

FastAPI delivers lightning-fast API responses, making it perfect for applications that demand low latency and high throughput. Combined with Flutter’s rich, responsive UIs, it helps to create high-performance solutions for business.

Benefits for Cross-Platform App Development

Single Codebase

Flutter makes it possible to create apps using one codebase – for mobile, web, and desktop versions. This results in faster time-to-market. You can save on development as the cost of Flutter app developers for hire will be lower than when you need to hire separately.

Hot Reload

Coders don’t need to restart the app to see the changes they make due to the hot reload feature. So it’s possible to test designs and layouts, make updates, and debug codes much faster. This way, when you hire a Flutter developer, you significantly reduce the development time.

Cross-Platform Nature

Owing to the cross-platform compatibility, developers can use the same Flutter code for mobile, web, and desktop apps. This brings consistent user experience and helps potential customers recognize your brand. Also, a Flutter software engineer has to maintain only one codebase, which simplifies bug fixes and streamlines updates.

Native App Performance

Flutter offers a unified and native-ike experience on all popular platforms owing to the framework’s plug-ins that can access cameras, accelerometers, GPS, and other native elements of devices. Also, a professional Flatter programmer can easily make applications perform as reliably as native mobile apps.

Expressive UI

Hire Flutter developers to create good-looking and packed-with-features apps, easily and effectively. Skia, Flutter’s engine, and the latest Flutter tools ensure fast and smooth graphics rendering to help you customize the appearance of your digital solution. And for creating complex but elegant designs, the best solution is Flutter as well.

Google Support

Google released Flutter in 2018, and in 2022, it became the most popular cross-platform mobile framework. Thousands of Flutter developers for hire around the globe use this framework to create advanced apps. The tech giant keeps investing in Flutter development, which means this cutting-edge toolkit will continue to improve.

Open-Source Community

Since Flutter is an open-source software development kit, it encourages developers to collaborate on its improvement. For instance, Stack Overflow has around 173k questions about Flutter, and Reddit boasts 123k members in the FlutterDev community. 1,315 contributors on GitHub and 634 groups on LinkedIn prove that any Flutter engineer can find support and advice.

FAQs on Hiring Flutter Developers

What does a Flutter developer do?

Flutter developers can help to build mobile, web, and desktop applications. These developers use Flutter, Google’s open-source framework with a single codebase, reducing the time and cost for creating apps for iOS, Android, Web, and Desktop. Key responsibilities include UI development, cross-platform development, integration with APIs, performance optimization, continuous integration and deployment, state management, testing and debugging.

Can you help with developer technical interviews?

Sure, if you want to hire and make a fully informed decision – tech interviewers and senior developers from our team can assist with that. We can assess candidates’ technical abilities and performance, providing detailed feedback. This ensures that you make informed decisions based on both technical proficiency and the cultural fit within your team.

What kind of apps can you build with Flutter?

Using this versatile framework, app developers create a wide range of app solutions, from simple mobile applications to complex IoT apps, AR apps, banking & payment, and feature-rich enterprise-grade platforms. Its cross-platform capabilities make it possible for Flutter developers to build apps for iOS, Android, Web, and Desktop all from a single codebase.

Can your Flutter developer take over my incomplete project?

Yes, we can. When you hire Flutter developers from us, they can easily step into projects at any stage to ensure their successful completion. Whether your project is facing a bottleneck, struggling with code quality, or simply needs an extra hand to speed up the process of delivery – we can help you move forward.

Which state management approach does Mobilunity use?

You’ll get the data management approach that’s optimal for your project scope and its complexity. When you hire remote Flutter developers from our team, you get professionals who have worked with Riverpod, Redux, BLoC, and Provider. After careful analysis, we’re going to help you select the best-suited approach to organize your codebase.

Can your Flitter devs integrate third-party plugins?

Yes, our Flutter developers can help you integrate third-party plugins into your Flutter applications. Whether you’re looking to add a payment gateway, authentication services, maps / geolocation, analytics & tracking, or any other third-party service, we can help you seamlessly add the functionality you need to drive your business.

Can I hire a Flutter developer for a project or on-demand basis?

Yes, you can. If you have a specific, well-defined project that requires Flutter expertise, you can hire an expert Flutter developer for the duration of the project. If you need maximum flexibility, for example, when you just need some extra support for specific tasks, features, or components – on-demand / part-time hiring would work at its best.

Can you move an existing app to Flutter?

Mobilunity’s software experts can help you move. Our best Flutter programmers can help with migrating or porting existing apps from native platforms (such as iOS or Android) or other frameworks to Flutter, helping you leverage its cross-platform benefits in full.

Do you provide support and maintenance services after deployment?

Sure, we can help you with the full scope of Flutter development services, including ongoing support and maintenance services after deployment. Our dedicated Flutter app developers will ensure that your app continues to function smoothly, efficiently, and securely in the long term. Whether you need bug fixes, feature additions, or just regular updates – we will get you covered.

Do you provide NDA and IP protection for my project?

Taking the confidentiality of your project and intellectual property very seriously, Mobilunity provides Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA) and ensures strong data protection for all our clients, including those hiring Flutter developers and other software development specialists or consultants. You as the client will hold full ownership over the IP produced on the project – this is an integral part of our model fully reflected in our contract!
